def evaluate_board(board, my_color, opp_color, total_contrib, safety_weight=5):
    my_inf = 0.0
    opp_inf = 0.0
    for i in range(SIZE*SIZE):
        if board[i] == my_color:
            my_inf += total_contrib[i]
        elif board[i] == opp_color:
            opp_inf += total_contrib[i]

    visited = [False]*(SIZE*SIZE)
    my_atari = 0
    opp_atari = 0
    for i in range(SIZE*SIZE):
        if not visited[i] and board[i] != 0:
            color = board[i]
            stack = [i]
            group = []
            libs = set()
            while stack:
                cur = stack.pop()
                if visited[cur]:
                    continue
                visited[cur] = True
                group.append(cur)
                for nb in NEIGHBORS[cur]:
                    if board[nb] == 0:
                        libs.add(nb)
                    elif board[nb] == color and not visited[nb]:
                        stack.append(nb)
            if len(libs) == 1:
                if color == my_color:
                    my_atari += len(group)
                else:
                    opp_atari += len(group)
    safety = safety_weight * (opp_atari - my_atari)
    return inf_diff + safety
